traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP are satisfied.
• Core Functionality & Plugin Structure (REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE): The plugin loads and registers rules/configs correctly, with meta bound to package.json, as asserted by tests/plugin-setup.test.ts and tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts (all passing in the latest Jest run).
• Rule Registry & Config System (REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM): The default export exposes a populated rules object and recommended/strict config presets; tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts verifies rule names and that both presets contain the expected rule severities.
• ESLint v9 Flat Config Integration (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT): tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts uses FlatESLint to lint code with this plugin’s recommended/strict configs under the flat-config API and confirms the traceability rules are enabled and working.
• Error Handling (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING): tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts confirms robust handling of rule load failures via placeholder rules and console error logging; tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts verifies the ESLint CLI exits with an error and appropriate messaging when rules fail/missing.
• TypeScript & Test Setup (REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-TEST-SETUP): Source and tests are written in TypeScript with a Jest-based test infrastructure, wired via package.json scripts (build, type-check, test), and the full suite passes.
• Documentation & UX: README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md exist and (per previous assessment) describe installation and ESLint 9 configuration; docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md and docs/custom-rules-development-guide.md document plugin structure and rule development. No changes in the story conflict with this, and all referenced behavior continues to be validated by passing tests.
Given the unchanged story text, the presence of all specified files, and a fresh successful npm test -- --verbose run that includes all 001.0-related suites, the story is fully implemented and remains in a passing state.
